summary: Jayud Global Logistics Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 22, 2026. Shareholders approved six proposals, including ratification of the 2025 audited financial statements, authorization for a share consolidation at a ratio between 2:1 and 250:1 within three years, and an increase in authorized share capital to at least 50,000,000 shares. The filing is a routine disclosure of corporate governance actions, not a special situation. No special terms like price, premium, or break fee are present. This is a standard AGM outcome report with no event-driven angle.
